[← Back to CV](../../)

# SpaceXAI Ambassadors

![SpaceXAI](../../assets/companies/spacexai.png)**SpaceXAI Europe Regional Lead & Madrid Ambassador.** I started as Cursor Madrid Ambassador in May 2025, then Europe Regional Lead—meetups, cafés, hackathons with coworkings, startups, and universities. Now the work is connecting builders across Europe: workshops, founder circles, and the same shipping-heavy community, at a larger scale.

After Cursor was [acquired by SpaceX](https://cursor.com/blog/joining-spacex), the community continues as **SpaceXAI Ambassadors**. Going forward that is Grok Bot meetups and similar. [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/spacexai-community).

Visual log below: events I've organized, and community events I've supported across Europe. More photos: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/felipe-basurto-barrio/).

organized_events.title: SpaceXAI Ambassadors
organized_events.body_md: Cursor was [acquired by SpaceX](https://cursor.com/blog/joining-spacex). The community program was renamed to **SpaceXAI Ambassadors**.

organized_events.title: Cursor Community Regional Lead (Europe)
organized_events.body_md: Promoted to **Cursor Community Regional Lead for Europe**. What started hosting meetups in Madrid—hackathons, workshops, founder circles—now includes connecting builders across the continent.

organized_events.title: 2nd Cursor Meetup
organized_events.body_md:
Partners **Tinybird** and **Kfund**. Talks from both, then demos and hallway chats.

- **getshell.ai** — shell-based agent workflows (OpenClaw) demoed for builders.
- **Cursor** — **Cloud Agents** and the onboarding flow ([cursor.com/onboard](https://cursor.com/onboard)).

organized_events.title: Café Cursor
organized_events.body_md:
All-day **casual coworking** at a café: people shipped their own projects, met other Cursor users, and talked shop — no talk track, no demos.

Venue **eito** with three zones (main workspace, quieter back, upstairs hub).

**Cursor engineers** on-site for debugging and Q&A.

organized_events.title: Cursor Hackathon × HappyRobot × Kibo Ventures
organized_events.body_md:
Challenge: integrate a **HappyRobot AI agent** into a working product using Cursor.

**Winners**

1. **TravelBot** — corporate travel end to end (stays, transport, dining).
2. **MedTracker** — automated daily calls to elderly relatives for medication check-ins.
3. **Santa's Call** — Santa calls your kid about behavior and wish lists.

organized_events.title: First Cursor Hackathon (Madrid)
organized_events.body_md:
Partners **Enzo Ventures**, **OneCoWork**, **productmakers.ai**. We opened with a build block; good turnout and a waitlist.

Theme: **gamification** — **~2 hours** to ship with Cursor.

**Winners**

1. **RoomieScore** — chores, expenses, and co-living for roommates.
2. **FocoQuest** — productivity as missions and progression.
3. **FinPlay** — personal finance made visual.

organized_events.title: First official Cursor meetup (Madrid)
organized_events.body_md: Hosted at **Google for Startups Madrid** with **Takos**. Community lightning talks and project demos from attendees.

organized_events.title: Cursor Madrid Ambassador
organized_events.body_md: Joined as **Cursor Madrid Ambassador**—meetups, workshops, and ties with local coworkings and universities. This is where the community work started.

sponsored_events.title: Cursor × TechIE Hackathon — IE University
sponsored_events.body_md: The biggest Cursor hackathon IE has run — auditorium, full house. TechIE × Cursor: students building ambitious projects with an AI-native workflow, not quick demos.

sponsored_events.title: Refugio Madrid 2026
sponsored_events.body_md: Upcoming — Saturday at Matadero Madrid. Morning talks + hackathon (~15 teams, AI-native build); afternoon ecosystem session and networking. Cursor sponsoring.

sponsored_events.title: HackSpain 2026
